name: Lectric XP Lite 2.0 Folding Electric Bike
verdict: The best value folding e-bike — lightweight, folds for a trunk or apartment, with a long-range battery option and hydraulic brakes.
description: The Lectric XP Lite 2.0 is the lightweight, affordable folding e-bike that makes electric riding accessible. It folds down to fit in a car trunk or a small apartment, and at a far lighter weight than the fat-tire XP models it's genuinely easy to carry. The 48V system delivers a peak 819W of power with 5 levels of pedal assist plus a throttle, and the long-range battery option stretches range up to 80 miles. Hydraulic brakes, an LCD display, and a quick-fold frame round out one of the best-selling e-bikes on Amazon.
features: Folds to fit a trunk or apartment
Peak 819W power with throttle + 5 pedal-assist levels
Lightweight, easy to carry and store
pros: Long-range battery option reaches up to 80 miles
Hydraulic brakes at an affordable price
One of the best-selling e-bikes on Amazon
cons: Lighter frame means a lower weight capacity than fat-tire models

name: Aventon Soltera 3 ADV Electric Bike
verdict: The best lightweight commuter e-bike — a torque sensor that rewards your effort in a clean, bike-like package.
description: The Aventon Soltera 3 ADV is for riders who want a light, bike-like electric ride rather than a heavy motorcycle-style e-bike. The torque sensor multiplies your pedaling effort so assist feels natural, and the lightweight frame means it still rides well even with the power off. The 250W motor (500W peak) handles commutes and errands with around 50 miles of range, and the hidden battery keeps the look clean. Integrated lighting and a Shimano drivetrain make it a practical, good-looking daily commuter.
features: Torque sensor for natural pedal assist
pros: Torque sensor feels natural and rewards effort
Light enough to ride comfortably unpowered
cons: Lower peak power than fat-tire models
